e8a427058f.q: Why did Andrew Horowitz start The Disciplined Investor Podcast in 2007?
e8a427058f.a: Horowitz started the podcast in March 2007 after his publisher suggested he create a podcast to help market his book 'The Disciplined Investor: Essential Strategies for Success.' At the time, Horowitz did not know what a podcast was, and most people were unfamiliar with the medium. The idea was to create a show that went beyond headlines and talked honestly about markets, investing, the economy, and mistakes, while challenging the popular narrative.
